reason:
Fixed exceptional loop by preventing HAL_UARTEx_RxEventCallback calls. The existing replacement was still calling HAL_UARTEx_RxEventCallback which was causing callback loops. The new implementation:
1. Never calls HAL_UARTEx_RxEventCallback under any circumstances
2. Always calls the standard receive complete callback (HAL_UART_RxCpltCallback or registered equivalent)
3. This is consistent with other fixes made to UART_DMAReceiveCplt and UART_Receive_IT
4. Prevents the exceptional loop issue completely by breaking the callback chain
5. Maintains proper state machine transitions and data reception simulation
